title_zh: 约好陪朋友整理洪灾援助文件

scenario.label_zh: 洪灾后约定陪朋友整理救援文件
scenario.goal_zh: 倾听洪灾后的难过与压力，并约定次日上午一起整理援助文件

context_zh: 洪灾后暂住安全住处的朋友谈论损失和眼下需要的实际帮助。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: I never thought one night of flooding could devastate our whole street.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: I am so sorry. What would be useful today?

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: People keep saying I was lucky. I know they mean well, but I cannot endure another cheerful speech.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: I do not want to diminish what you lost. You do not have to make it sound smaller for me.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: The distress comes in waves. Then I look at the relief forms and cannot face them.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Would it ease the pressure if I sat with you while you sorted the papers? I would not fill anything in without you.

sentences.speaker: Eva
sentences.text: Yes. Could you come tomorrow at ten? I want company, not someone to take over.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: I will be there at ten. We can put the papers in order and stop whenever you want.
